overview.Module Title: Contemporary Planning Practice in Western Europe and the North America

sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module aims to make students conversant with the West European, UK and US contemporary planning systems and their historical developments.
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Describe the key elements of contemporary planning systems in West Europe, UK, and the US. B. Explain the chronological growth and development of Western planning, with a focus on town planning in the UK; C. Discuss issues, challenges, operations and policy options of contemporary Western Planning. D. Demonstrate a critical approach to Western planning practices and the capability to compare cases from different socio-institutional and economic contexts
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The module seeks to provide a varied learning experience, combining lectures, tutorials and discussion. Their delivery is designed to provide experiences of current issues and practices, and stimulate a comparative approach through lectures, discussions and presentation.
